AGENDA
  CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION MEETING
  Council Chambers, City Hall – 613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor
  Glendale, CA 91206

Welcome to the meeting of the Civil Service Commission. Meetings are broadcast live on cable channel 6 (GTV6) and rebroadcast throughout the
week. Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. DVDs and Videotapes of the proceedings are available for purchase in the City Clerk’s Office by
  calling (818) 548-2090. Please turn off cellular phones and pagers while inside the Council Chambers.

 In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign language translation, and Braille transcripts are
available upon request. Assisted listening devices are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required
  for requests regarding sign language translation and Braille transcription services.

All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are public records, will
  be available for review in the Human Resources office, 613 E. Broadway, Room 100, Glendale, CA 91206.

  If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for assistance, please contact Human Resources at (818) 548-2110 during
  regular business hours.

  April 10, 2019 at 5:00 p.m.
  1.  ROLL CALL

  2.  MINUTES (Page 3)
  Action: Consideration of the Minutes for the meeting of March 13, 2019.

  3.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items NOT part of the agenda. Each speaker is limited to five minutes.
  Commission may question the speaker, but there will be no debate or decision.

  4.  RECRUITMENT AND EXAMINATION REPORT (Page 5)
  No action required.

  5.  ELIGIBLE LISTS ESTABLISHED (Page 7)
  No action required.

  6.  CLASS SPECIFICATION FOR APPROVAL – CHIEF INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY ARCHITECT
  (NAVARRO) (Page 8)
  Action: Approval of class specification for Chief Information Technology Architect as submitted.

  7.  CLASS SPECIFICATION FOR APPROVAL – LEGAL SECRETARY SERIES AND JOB BULLETIN FOR
  APPROVAL – LEGAL EXECUTIVE SECRETARY (MARTIN) (Page 14)
  Action: Approval of class specification for Legal Secretary Series and Job Bulletin for Legal Executive
  Secretary as submitted.

  8.  JOB BULLETINS FOR APPROVAL – FIREFIGHTER RECRUIT/PARAMEDIC AND FIREFIGHTER
  RECRUIT/PARAMEDIC (PROMOTIONAL) (CHAVEZ) (Page 28)
  Action: Approval of job bulletins for Firefighter Recruit/Paramedic and Firefighter Recruit/Paramedic
  (Promotional) as submitted.

  9.  REPORTS – INFORMATION (Page 40)
  a) Past Due Employee Performance Evaluations.

  10. CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION/STAFF COMMENTS
   11. CLOSED SESSION
  a) Public Employee Discipline: Police Officer

  12. ADJOURNMENT
  Action: Move to adjourn.

As required by law, this agenda for the Civil Service Commission Meeting of April 10, 2019 was posted at or
before 4:00 p.m. on April 5, 2019 on the City Hall Bulletin Board.

f  CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION
  MINUTES
  April 10, 2019
  City Council Chambers

  1.  ROLL CALL
  Chair MacCarley called the meeting to order at 5:11 pm.

  Present: Manoukian, Ghazarian, Devine, Abkarian, Chair MacCarley. Commissioner Manoukian arrived during
  the discussion of item #3.

  Z.  MINUTES
  Action: Consideration of the Minutes for the meeting of March 13, 2019.

  Motion: Ghazarian  Second: Devine
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous
  Absent: Manoukian

  3.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items NOT a port of the agenda. Each speaker is limited to five minutes. Commission
  may question the speaker, but there will be no debate or decision.

  None

  4.  RECRUITMENT AND EXAMINATION REPORT
  Mr. Doyle reviewed the Recruitment and Examination Report.

  5.  ELIGIBLE LISTS ESTABLISHED
  Mr. Doyle reviewed the Eligible Lists Established.

  6.  CLASS SPECIFICATION FOR APPROVAL- CHIEF INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY ARCHITECT (NAVARRO)
  Action: Approval of class specification for Chief Information Technology Architect as submitted.

  The class specification for Chief Information Technology Architect was approved as submitted by the
  following vote:

  Motion: Abkarian  Second: Manoukian
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous

  7.  CLASS SPECIFICATION FOR APPROVAL- LEGAL SECRETARY SERIES ANO JOB BULLETIN FOR APPROVAL-
  LEGAL EXECUTIVE SECRETARY (MARTIN)
  Action: Approval of class specification for Legal Secretary Series and job bulletin for Legal Executive Secretary
  as submitted.

  The class specification for Legal Secretary Series and job bulletin for Legal Executive Secretary was approved
  with a modification that removes language that pertains to the knowledge of addition, subtraction,
  multiplication, and division.

  Motion: Abkarian  Second: Ghazarian
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous

  8.  JOB BULLETIN FOR APPROVAL- FIREFIGHTER RECRUIT/PARAMEDIC AND FIREFIGHTER
  RECRUIT/PARAMEDIC (PROMOTIONAL) (CHAVEZ)
  Action: Approval of job bulletin for Firefighter Recruit/Paramedic and Firefighter Recruit/Paramedic
  (Promotional) as submitted.
   Civil Service Commission Minutes of April 10, 2019
  Page 2 of 2

  The job bulletin for Firefighter Recruit/Paramedic and Firefighter Recruit/Paramedic (Promotional) was
  approved as submitted by the following vote:

  Motion: Manoukian  Second: Abkarian
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous

9.  REPORTS- INFORMATION
  a)  Past Due Employee Performance Evaluations.

  Mr. Doyle reviewed the Past Due Employee Performance Evaluations Report.

10.  CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION/STAFF COMMENTS
  None

11.  CLOSED SESSION
  a) Public Employee Discipline: Police Officer

12.  ADJOURNMENT
  Action: Move to adjourn.

  There being no further business to come before the Commission, the meeting was adjourned at 5:34 pm.

  We, the members of the Civil Service Commission of the City of Glendale, certify that the foregoing Minutes
  cord of our proceedings of April 10, 2019.
